checkResults.description: Model produced component code with exports/imports
Named exports only — no default exports
Chips must use aria-pressed for toggle state

SR-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ChipBar component that renders a row of filter chips. Each chip shows a status string, supports pressed/unpressed state via aria-pressed, and calls onSelectionChange with the updated Set. Include the CSS file with the component.
SR-01.output:
The `ChipBar` component is written at `src/components/ChipBar/ChipBar.tsx` with:

- **`statuses: string[]`** — list of status strings to render as chips
- **`selected: Set<string>`** — controlled selection state
- **`onSelectionChange: (updated: Set<string>) => void`** — called with a new `Set` on each toggle
- Each chip is a `<button aria-pressed={true|false}>` — toggles its status in/out of the selected set on click
- `ChipBar.css` uses `--shelf-chip-*` component-tier tokens for all visual values, with `appearance: none` and explicit `background-color` on every button state

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
